description: This file defines an abstract base class `CvdCommandHandler` in the `cuttlefish` namespace. The class specifies a set of pure virtual functions for handling command-line interface commands related to 'cvd' (cuttlefish virtual device). It includes methods for checking if commands can be handled, executing commands, and providing help descriptions.

classes.name: CvdCommandHandler
classes.description: Abstract base class for handling 'cvd' commands in a command-line interface, defining virtual methods for command processing and help generation.

methods.name: CanHandle
methods.description: Determines if this handler can process the given command request.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the command request; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: CmdList
methods.description: Returns a list of subcommands that this handler can process.

methods.name: SummaryHelp
methods.description: Provides a brief help text for the command.

methods.name: ShouldInterceptHelp
methods.description: Indicates if help requests should be intercepted.

methods.name: DetailedHelp
methods.description: Provides detailed help text for the command.
